title: Royals
headline: Lorde found the title for 'Royals' on a 1976 baseball shirt. The lyrics took her half an hour.
caption:
A teenager in New Zealand, a baseball photo from 1976, and a diary line from when she was 12. That's how 'Royals' started.

One more twist: a song about growing up far from the glamour got covered by Bruce Springsteen, who played an acoustic version in Auckland in 2014. Lorde said "it's crazy when someone like him is playing your song".

Where were you the first time you heard 'Royals'?

🎧 The song: "Royals" by Lorde (@lorde)
